description: Update an existing webhook: change url (HTTPS only), the subscribed events, or set deactivate=true to switch the webhook to INACTIVE. `events` is the full subscription list, not a delta — to add CUSTOMER_CHANGED to an existing webhook, read it with get_webhook first and send its current events plus the new one. Call get_operation_schema("UpdateWebhook") for the exact request shape.

webhook.description: Fields to update, matching the UpdateWebhookRequest schema (see get_operation_schema("UpdateWebhook")). Must not be empty.

name: update_webhook
title: Update webhook
